description: Source code for a wizard interface managing employee sign-in and sign-out processes in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form definitions, logic for sign-in/out actions, and state transitions.

classes.name: wiz_si_so
classes.description: Wizard interface class handling sign-in/sign-out workflow with multiple states and user interactions.

methods.name: _get_empid
methods.description: Retrieves employee ID, name, and state based on current user ID.

methods.name: _sign_in
methods.description: Handles employee sign-in process, creating attendance record and updating status.

methods.name: _sign_out
methods.description: Handles employee sign-out process, creating attendance record and updating status.

methods.name: _si_check
methods.description: Determines whether the employee should sign in or sign out based on last attendance action.

methods.name: _so_check
methods.description: Checks last attendance action to decide if sign-out or sign-in is appropriate.
